definitions.explanation: A literary or formal way to say 'many' or 'numerous,' emphasizing a large but unspecified number of things. Conveys a sense of weight and significance, often used when looking back on experiences or challenges.

examples.japanese: {幾多|いくた}の⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えた→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧。
{幾多|いくた}の⟦{試練|しれん}→試練：14173_shiren⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経|へ}て→経る：13876_heru⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Through countless trials, he became stronger.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{幾多|いくた}の⟦{自然|しぜん}{災害|さいがい}→自然災害：29290_shizensaigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見舞|みま}われ→見舞う：14133_mimau⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧たび⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{復興|ふっこう}して→復興する：25381_fukkousuru⟧きた。
examples.english: This region has been hit by numerous natural disasters, yet it has recovered each time.

notes:
USAGE:
A literary and somewhat elevated expression. Typically modifies nouns related to hardship, experience, or significance: ⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧ (difficulties), ⟦{試練|しれん}→試練：14173_shiren⟧ (trials), ⟦{犠牲|ぎせい}→犠牲：14743_gisei⟧ (sacrifices), ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧ (experiences).
More formal and literary than ⟦{数多|かずおお}く→数多く：12948_kazuooku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ or ⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧. Rarely used in casual conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {幾多|いくた}の⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧ (numerous difficulties)
- {幾多|いくた}の⟦{試練|しれん}→試練：14173_shiren⟧ (countless trials)
- {幾多|いくた}の⟦{犠牲|ぎせい}→犠牲：14743_gisei⟧ (many sacrifices)
- {幾多|いくた}の⟦{変遷|へんせん}→変遷：05571_hensen⟧ (many changes/transitions)
